population.repeat: one additional R2 workers1 capture per surroundings/platform tuple
population.order: surroundings order above, workers1 then4, legacy/R2/A1 on even surroundings indices and A1/R2/legacy on odd indices; repeats last

capture.sample_clock: one observation per actual main-thread physics step; native ticks and result sample ages recorded separately
capture.cutoff: stop stepping when the first observed native tick is at or above release_native_tick+1200; record actual tick and any observed overshoot
capture.derivatives: retain raw pose/velocity samples; finite differences require positive recorded physics-step dt and both endpoints; no synthetic endpoint at cutoff

metric_definitions.reference_entry_com_cells: max(0,max(observed body COM.y-release COM.y)); fixture-relative downward entry proxy, not cell penetration
metric_definitions.reference_union_bottom_entry: current maximum y of all24 original rectangle corners minus its release value; exact union extent, not stored-cell overlap
metric_definitions.pre_overlap: native copied pre-displacement stored-cell overlap if available; otherwise null
metric_definitions.post_overlap: native copied post-displacement stored-cell overlap if available; otherwise null
metric_definitions.lowest_union_at_or_below_floor_y: lowest union corner y>=72; geometric plane flag only, not Rapier contact or finite-floor intersection
metric_definitions.conservation_census: registered source fixture region(0,0,160,128); exact reported regional counts, not an unmeasured full-world census
metric_definitions.actually_applied_wrench: accepted application receipts only, deduplicated by snapshot; rejected receipt contributes zero; absent receipt remains null

capture.asynchronous_pacing: actual CyberSimulationWorker and main-thread Rapier; no second native clock

compound.comparison_scope: whole coupling composition; legacy cap3 and GCR normal20 are retained and are not capacity matched

physical_gates.primary: R2 packed_sand/embedded_sand penetration and overlap against same-build legacy, separately per platform/workers; permitted worsening max(absolute allowance,relative allowance*abs(reference))
physical_gates.controls: zero new granular contribution for hard/Empty/Water-only mechanical controls; do not zero existing non-granular Water response
physical_gates.conservation: exact aggregate member tuples and sole ownership; exact Sand count and integer Water mass, with explicit external-edit ledger
physical_gates.unsupported: a missing prerequisite or metric gives null gate, never a pass or false zero
physical_gates.A1: bounded admission diagnostic; no law tuning and no inferred efficacy/default acceptance
physical_gates.repeatability: measured same-build workers1 R2 repeats; do not assert asynchronous or cross-platform dynamic equality
physical_gates.timing: functional asynchronous timings only; no uncontended performance qualification
